code_mappings: Native option insertion order and its reverse; exactly two unique mappings.
coverage: Missing other code is fetched with identical prompt and forced singleton; no floor.
output_contract: Intermediate native key only; not a complete native JSON/explanation head.
reasoned: Original full messages + entire newly generated raw response + identical selector. The prior response can contain an answer key as well as explanation because the original native contract is retained. No old historical answer; no field extraction.
selection: All fixed 16 pilot NLI and all 16 author-native controls; gold offline only; no prior.
interpretation: Tests presence of a preceding free-generated response, not the isolated causal effect of explanation text.
review_resolution: Before GPU launch, reviewed the native output-contract ambiguity and retained frozen code/prompts; corrected the control description only.
